```sql
SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(track_cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_tracking_records
FROM (
  SELECT s.status, s.shipment_id, COUNT(t.tracking_id) AS track_cnt
  FROM shipments s
  LEFT JOIN shipment_tracking t ON t.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  GROUP BY s.status, s.shipment_id
) x
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 100;
```
message.reasoning_content:
目标：按发货状态统计每个发货单平均轨迹记录数，等权（每张发货单权重相同），保留0条轨迹的发货单。结果两位小数。

需要 shipments 左连接 shipment_tracking，按 shipments.status 分组。注意每张发货单轨迹可能多条，要 COUNT(tracking_id)。包括0条，LEFT JOIN 后 COUNT(t.tracking_id) 为0。平均 = SUM(轨迹数)/COUNT(发货单) = AVG(COUNT 按发货单) 或 SUM(count)/COUNT(DISTINCT shipment_id)。因为 LEFT JOIN 后每个 shipment 的行数等于轨迹数，COUNT(t.tracking_id) 总数 / COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id)。但如果一张发货单无轨迹，LEFT JOIN 一行 tracking_id NULL，COUNT(NULL)=0，DISTINCT shipment_id 计1，正确。

更稳妥：先按 shipment 聚合轨迹数，再按 status 平均。不过直接 LEFT JOIN 后 GROUP BY status：SUM(tracking_id count)/COUNT(DISTINCT shipment_id)。若 tracking 表对 shipment 多条，COUNT(t.tracking_id) = 总轨迹数。除以发货单数。OK。

输出状态原值。ROUND(AVG...) numeric。需要 ROUND 两位。AVG 返回 numeric 当输入 bigint? AVG(bigint) 返回 numeric 在 PG 中。COUNT 返回 bigint，AVG(bigint) numeric。可以直接 ROUND(..., 2)。表达式：ROUND(COUNT(t.tracking_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id),0), 2)。或 AVG 每单轨迹数先子查询。

使用：SELECT s.status, ROUND(COUNT(t.tracking_id)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id), 2) AS avg_tracking_count FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN shipment_tracking t ON t.shipment_id=s.shipment_id GROUP BY s.status ORDER BY s.status;

问题“按发货状态统计每张发货单等权的平均物流轨迹记录数两位；包括0条轨迹的发货单。” 需要包括0。分组status。排序？没有明确，可按 status。状态列原值。需要 LIMIT 因为 GROUP BY 行数少但硬性规则3要求必须LIMIT（有GROUP BY不是单行聚合）。加 LIMIT 100。

ROUND numeric：COUNT(t.tracking_id)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id) 结果 numeric。COUNT DISTINCT 不会0除非status组有行，有行则至少1。但可NULLIF安全。ROUND 两位。

注意“每张发货单等权”意味着不要被轨迹多行放大。上述除法正确，因为分子总轨迹数，分母发货单数，每单等权贡献轨迹数。也可以先子查询：SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(cnt),2) FROM (SELECT s.status, s.shipment_id, COUNT(t.tracking_id) cnt FROM ... GROUP BY s.status,s.shipment_id) x GROUP BY status。这个更清晰，避免 DISTINCT 陷阱。使用子查询 AVG(cnt) 返回 numeric。输出。

LIMIT 100。ORDER BY status。

SQL：
SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(track_cnt)::numeric, 2) AS avg_tracking_records
FROM (
  SELECT s.status, s.shipment_id, COUNT(t.tracking_id) AS track_cnt
  FROM shipments s
  LEFT JOIN shipment_tracking t ON t.shipment_id = s.shipment_id
  GROUP BY s.status, s.shipment_id
) x
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
LIMIT 100;

AVG(COUNT bigint) -> numeric? AVG(bigint) returns numeric。::numeric 安全。两位。

仅投影 status 和平均。status 原值 smallint。好。
